entries.zh: 价钱少，便宜（贱价的价钱）
entries.en: cheap in price, costing little; a low price
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字作「火」，而 M/R 两栏记音 chiò/siào 均合「少」字，字形疑误认；释义据音读栏与西语词头「价钱便宜」推定。

entries.en: to cheapen, to beat the price down; baratar also 'to barter'
cheap, low in price; lowly, base

entries.zh: 烂贱，（东西腐烂故）极贱、贱得不值钱
entries.en: dirt-cheap, very cheap, as a rotten thing worth nothing
entries.notes: M 栏夹注西语「como podrido no vale nada」（如腐烂之物不值钱），与汉字栏「爛賤」正合。

entries.zh: 时价，市价（按当时行情的价钱）
entries.en: the current price, market price according to the times

entries.zh: 赏钱，（游戏赌局中）所给的彩钱、赏金
entries.en: prize money given in a game or gamble; reward money, tip

entries.zh: 打贱，杀价（把价钱压打下去）
entries.en: to beat the price down, to haggle it cheap (the headword carries a marginal note 'ab aratar')
a good price, the price well spoken of ('what a good bargain')

entries.zh: 胡须，须（又作嘴须：嘴边之须）
entries.en: beard, whiskers; also whiskers of the mouth
the hairs above the beard, i.e. the moustache
entries.notes: 汉字栏「鬍」与 M/R 栏音读 liam/liên 不吻合（音近「髯」＝面颊之须），且 R 栏注涂改；义据西语「其上方之毛」定作嘴上之须。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（汉字栏作「口斗」，音读栏「嘴斗」，西语词头讹乱）
entries.en: damaged entry, gloss uncertain: literal 'mouth tau'; the Spanish headword is garbled
entries.notes: 西语词头「no alla boca, no respelo」不成句，三栏虽一致记「嘴斗」二字而其义无考，语义无法定夺，不作臆断。

entries.zh: 城墙，（城上凸出之）碉楼；矮墙
entries.en: barbican (watchtower on a wall), rampart; low enclosing wall
entries.notes: 汉字栏「埒」（垣埒矮墙）与西语 muralla 义合，但 M/R 栏音读 coz/cōn 与「埒」音不合，字音有一误，释义据西语词头与汉字义推定。

entries.zh: 剃头匠，理发师（字面「笓照」，约梳篦照镜之业；原稿「剃笓人」已删）
entries.en: barber (literal characters 'comb and mirror'; the deleted draft read 'shave-comb man')
entries.notes: R 栏自注涂改难辨，原稿「剃笓人」删改存痕；理发匠之义据西语词头与删除稿「剃…人」推定。

entries.zh: 剃头，剃须梳篦（指剃头匠行当）
entries.en: shaving and combing, the barber's trade (barbero)
ferry, ferry-crossing, a boat for passing over
